text: Security is a crucial part of web development. When building a website, developers must protect both user data and the system itself. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts information sent between the browser and the server. Another important practice is authentication, which makes sure that only the right users can access certain areas. Developers should also use input validation to check what users type into forms, so that harmful code cannot enter the system. Finally, they need to understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and find ways to prevent them. Good security requires attention at every stage of development.
